text:
emma: heads up — starting in 5, quick agenda change: Ryan will do roadmap first, then Q&A. moving demo slot to the end.
devin: noted. mic check in the AV room?
tara: @mike-av can you confirm recorder is set to local + cloud? last time cloud dropped during the demo. :grimacing:
mike-av: recorder on local + cloud. obs instance 2 has failed encoder fallback flagged, i'm cycling.
ops-bot: Deploy watcher: encoder-fallback triggered on obs-2 at 3912345600. Auto-restart queued.
emma: thanks — if obs doesn't come back, we need to switch to backup feed (HDMI2 -> VMix). devin can you stand by for switch?
devin: on it. HDMI2 patched to vmix, pre-roll frame looks good.
samir: deck link in the meeting notes isn't loading for Ryan — getting a 403. anyone else?
ceo-ryan: I can load it on mobile. probably permission. @tara can you re-share public view?
tara: re-sharing now: https://drive.re/redwood/allhands/roadmap-v2 (public view)
ceo-ryan: got it, thanks. pulling slides.
emma: runbook reminder: if we need to hard cut recording, record local ISO and create splice marker in notes: 
```
# splice-marker
time: 00:23:12
reason: encoder-fallback
```

mike-av: obs-2 seems flakey after restart. suggest swapping main program to obs-1 and keeping obs-2 on backup for ISO capture. do we want to do that now?
devin: yes let's swap now. switching program bus to obs-1... done. audio levels stable.
ops-bot: Switch action: program switched to obs-1 at 3912345688 by devin.
emma: great. Ryan, we'll take roadmap -> Q&A -> demo. For Q&A: please leave 10 mins at end for rapid-fire. we'll collect questions in the thread.
samir: question: are we still planning the Dedicated multi-region pilot in Q3?
ceo-ryan: short answer: yes, pilot in late Q3. product will announce timeline in next week's roadmap email.
tara: follow-up: can we record a short clip of the demo in case live feed drops? mike-av can you loop a 30s pre-recorded fallback?
mike-av: yes, i'll queue a 30s slate and instructions. fallback clip stored at s3://redwood-backups/allhands/fallback-slate.mp4
emma: thanks team. if anything else pops up, drop it here and we won't interrupt the live mic unless urgent. :thumbsup:
devin: one last check — captions are enabled?
emma: captions enabled, auto-transcript ON.
ceo-ryan: heading on stage in 2. see you in the stream.
emma: starting in 1. everyone on comms stay ready.
_reserved_note: This file contains a single Slack thread. Messages are short and in chronological order, prefixed by sender name as required.
